entities.name: Mirian II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirian II or Mirvan (მირვანი) was a king (mepe) of Iberia from 30 to 20 BC. His reign marked the reinstatement of the Nimrodid Dynasty, a continuation of the P'arnabazids.
